/* A deliberately simple fallback, explicitly labelled as non-AI in the UI. */
function localText22(text,def){return text.replace(/(?<=\d),(?=\d{3}(?:\D|$))/g,'').split(/[，,、；;\n]|(?:還有|以及)/).map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(seg=>{
 const re=/(NT\$|TWD|JPY|¥|￥)?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(萬)?\s*(日幣|日圓|日元|円|yen|jpy|台幣|新台幣|NT\$?|twd|元|塊)?/gi;
 const matches=[...seg.matchAll(re)];const marked=matches.filter(m=>m[1]||/日|円|yen|jpy|台|新台|nt|twd/i.test(m[4]||''));const m=marked.at(-1)||matches.at(-1);
 const marker=m?(m[1]||'')+(m[4]||''):'';const currency=/台|nt|twd/i.test(marker)?'TWD':/日|円|yen|jpy|¥|￥/i.test(marker)?'JPY':def;
 let name=(m?seg.slice(0,m.index)+seg.slice(m.index+m[0].length):seg).replace(/^(我|今天|剛剛|剛才)?(買了?|吃了?|喝了?|搭了?|付了?|花了?|坐)/,'').replace(/(?:兩人|二人|2人)?(?:總共|一共|共)/g,'').trim()||'未辨識品項';

/* The deadline includes auth, upload and full JSON body. A late response never writes into UI. */
function withDeadline23(run,job){
 const signal=job.controller.signal;
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  let settled=false,timer;
  const finish=(err,value)=>{if(settled)return;settled=true;clearTimeout(timer);signal.removeEventListener('abort',onAbort);err?reject(err):resolve(value)};
  const onAbort=()=>finish(signal.reason||error23('已取消','cancelled'));
  const timeout=()=>job.controller.abort(error23('AI 超過 45 秒未完成','timeout'));
  signal.addEventListener('abort',onAbort,{once:true});
  if(signal.aborted){onAbort();return}
  timer=setTimeout(timeout,Math.max(0,job.deadline-Date.now()));
  Promise.resolve().then(()=>run(signal)).then(value=>{if(Date.now()>=job.deadline){timeout();return}finish(null,value)},err=>finish(err));
 });
}

/* Keep the old rule parser. Guard amounts so item counts and dates are not mistaken for prices. */
const localTextBase23=localText22;
localText22=function(text,def){
 const normalized=String(text||'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/(\d),(?=\d{3}(?:\D|$))/g,'$1');
 return normalized.split(/[，,、；;\n]|(?:還有|以及)/).map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(seg=>{
  const rows=localTextBase23(seg,def);if(!rows.length)return null;const row=rows[0];
  if(/(?:^|[^\d])\d{1,4}[\/\-]\d{1,2}(?:[\/\-]\d{1,2})?/.test(seg)&&!/(?:日幣|日圓|円|JPY|TWD|NT\$|台幣|新台幣|¥|￥)/i.test(seg)){row.name=seg.slice(0,60);row.amount=null}
  if(/(?:[-−]\s*\d)|(?:退款|退費|折扣)/.test(seg)){row.name=seg.slice(0,60);row.amount=null}
  const m=[...seg.matchAll(/(NT\$|TWD|JPY|¥|￥)?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(萬)?\s*(日幣|日圓|日元|円|yen|jpy|台幣|新台幣|NT\$?|twd|元|塊)?/gi)].at(-1);
  if(m&&!m[1]&&!m[4]&&/^\s*(?:人|個|顆|件|瓶|杯|碗|份|張|包|公克|公斤|kg|g|ml|cc)(?:\s|$|[，。])/i.test(seg.slice(m.index+m[0].length))){row.name=seg.slice(0,60);row.amount=null}
  if(/(?:USD|US\$|美元|美金|EUR|歐元|CNY|人民幣|RMB|HKD|港幣|韓元|KRW)/i.test(seg)){row.currency=null;row.name=seg.slice(0,60)}
  return row;
 }).filter(Boolean);
};

function validateBackup23(obj){
 let settings,expenses;
 if(obj?.format===BACKUP_FORMAT23){
  if(obj.version!==23||obj.trip?.year!==2026||JSON.stringify(obj.trip?.dates)!==JSON.stringify(D.days.map(d=>d.date)))throw Error('不是這趟四國旅行的記帳備份');
  settings=obj.settings;expenses=obj.expenses;
 }else if(obj?.schema===1&&Array.isArray(obj.expenses)){settings={defaultCurrency:obj.defaultCurrency||'JPY',rate:obj.rate,rateMode22:obj.rateMode22};expenses=obj.expenses;}
 else throw Error('檔案格式不符；請選擇 JSON 記帳備份或舊版設定檔');
 if(!settings||!['JPY','TWD'].includes(settings.defaultCurrency)||typeof settings.rate!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(settings.rate)||settings.rate<.000001||settings.rate>100)throw Error('備份的幣別或匯率不正確');
 if(!Array.isArray(expenses)||expenses.length>10000)throw Error('紀錄數量不正確或超過一萬筆');
 const rows=expenses.map((x,i)=>{if(!x||typeof x.name!=='string'||!x.name.trim()||x.name.length>60||typeof x.category!=='string'||!x.category.trim()||x.category.length>30||!validAmount22(x.amount)||!['JPY','TWD'].includes(x.currency)||!Number.isInteger(x.day)||x.day<0||x.day>=D.days.length)throw Error(`第 ${i+1} 筆資料不完整，未匯入任何資料`);return {name:x.name.trim(),category:cat22(x.category.trim()),amount:x.amount,currency:x.currency,day:x.day};});
 return {settings:{defaultCurrency:settings.defaultCurrency,rate:settings.rate,rateMode22:settings.rateMode22==='reference'&&settings.rate===FX_REFERENCE22.rate?'reference':'saved'},expenses:rows};
}

function parseJSON25(text) {
 let raw=String(text||'').trim();
 if (/^```/.test(raw)) raw=raw.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'');
 let parsed; try {parsed=JSON.parse(raw);} catch (_) {throw error23('AI 回覆不是完整 JSON','format');}
 return normalizeResult23(parsed);
}
function geminiPayload25(b) {
 const user={defaultCurrency:b.defaultCurrency,existingCategories:b.existingCategories,text:b.text};
 const parts=[{text:JSON.stringify(user)}];
 for (const im of b.images) {
  const m = /^data:(image\/(?:jpeg|png|webp));base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=\r\n]+)$/.exec(im.dataUrl||'');
  if(!m) throw error23('圖片格式無效','image');
  parts.push({inline_data:{mime_type:m[1],data:m[2].replace(/\s/g,'')}});
 }
 const schema = {
  type:'OBJECT', required:['items'],
  properties:{ items:{type:'ARRAY',items:{
   type:'OBJECT', required:['name','category','amount','currency'],
   properties:{name:{type:'STRING'},category:{type:'STRING'},
    amount:{type:'NUMBER',nullable:true},
    currency:{type:'STRING',enum:['JPY','TWD'],nullable:true}}
  }}}
 };
 return {systemInstruction:{parts:[{text:b.prompt}]},contents:[{role:'user',parts}],
  generationConfig:{responseMimeType:'application/json',responseSchema:schema}};
}
function apiErrorText25(e) {
 const code=String(e?.code||'');
 if (code==='timeout') return 'AI 超過 45 秒未完成';
 if (code==='manual-fallback') return '已停止等待 AI';
 if (code==='offline') return '目前沒有網路';
 if (code==='unconfigured') return '尚未填入 Gemini API 金鑰';
 if (code==='HTTP401'||code==='HTTP403') return 'Gemini 未接受金鑰或其使用權限，請檢查金鑰／網站限制';
 if (code==='HTTP400') return 'Gemini 拒絕請求，請檢查金鑰、模型或圖片格式';
 if (code==='HTTP404') return '這個 Gemini 模型目前無法使用，請到 AI 設定改模型';
 if (code==='HTTP429') return 'Gemini 額度或頻率受限';
 if (code==='format') return 'AI 回覆格式不完整';
 if (code==='blocked') return 'AI 未回傳可用的辨識內容';
 if (code==='image') return '圖片格式無效';
 if (code.startsWith('HTTP')) return 'Gemini 服務暫時無法使用（'+code.replace('HTTP','')+'）';
 return 'API 連線失敗，可能是網路或瀏覽器限制';
}

sendAI23 = async function(body,signal) {
 if (!apiKey25) throw error23('尚未設定金鑰','unconfigured');
 const started=Date.now(), model=apiModel25, key=apiKey25;
 const endpoint=API_HOST25+'/v1beta/models/'+encodeURIComponent(model)+':generateContent';
 apiReport25.state='sending'; apiReport25.http=null; apiReport25.message=''; apiReport25.model=model;
 const response=await fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','x-goog-api-key':key},credentials:'omit',referrerPolicy:'no-referrer',cache:'no-store',body:JSON.stringify(geminiPayload25(body)),signal});
 if (signal.aborted) throw signal.reason;
 apiReport25.http=response.status;
 if (!response.ok) { try {await response.body?.cancel();} catch (_) {} throw error23('Gemini HTTP '+response.status,'HTTP'+response.status); }
 let data;try{data=await response.json();}catch(e){if(signal.aborted)throw signal.reason;throw error23('AI 回覆格式錯誤','format');}
 if(signal.aborted)throw signal.reason;
 if(data.promptFeedback?.blockReason)throw error23('沒有可用內容','blocked');
 const candidate=data.candidates?.[0];
 if(!candidate||candidate.finishReason&&candidate.finishReason!=='STOP')throw error23('AI 未完整完成','format');
 const text=(candidate.content?.parts||[]).filter(p=>typeof p.text==='string'&&p.thought!==true).map(p=>p.text).join('');
 const result=parseJSON25(text);
 if(signal.aborted)throw signal.reason;
 apiReport25.seconds=Math.round((Date.now()-started)/100)/10;
 // Success is only published by parse22 after the active request/deadline guard accepts it.
 return result;
};

let voiceRun27 = null;
const VOICE_STOP_GRACE27 = 1200;
function liveVoice27(v) {
 return !!v && voiceRun27===v && !v.done && v.session===sheet22.session && v.session===seq22 && isSheet22();
}
function endVoice27(v,{abort=false,message='',send=false,quiet=false}={}) {
 if(!v||v.done)return;
 const active=liveVoice27(v);
 v.done=true;clearTimeout(v.timer);
 v.r.onstart=v.r.onresult=v.r.onerror=v.r.onend=null;
 if(voiceRun27===v)voiceRun27=null;
 if(rec22===v.r)rec22=null;
 micSend25=false;
 if(abort){try{v.r.abort();}catch(_){}}
 if(active&&!quiet){
  const text=document.getElementById('expense-text22')?.value;
  if(typeof text==='string')sheet22.text=text;
  sheet22.msg=message||(sheet22.text.trim()?'錄音已結束，文字已保留；修改後按「送出」。':'錄音已結束。');
  redraw22();
  if(send)parse22();
 }
}
function stopVoice27(send=false) {
 const v=voiceRun27;
 if(!v){
  if(rec22){const r=rec22;rec22=null;r.onend=r.onresult=r.onerror=null;try{r.abort();}catch(_){}}
  if(isSheet22()){sheet22.msg='錄音已結束。';redraw22();}
  return;
 }
 v.send=v.send||send;
 if(v.stopping){endVoice27(v,{abort:true,send:v.send});return;}
 v.stopping=true;
 // Arm the watchdog before stop(): some implementations fire onend synchronously.
 v.timer=setTimeout(()=>endVoice27(v,{abort:true,send:v.send}),VOICE_STOP_GRACE27);
 if(liveVoice27(v))redraw22();
 try{v.r.stop();}catch(_){endVoice27(v,{abort:true,send:v.send});}
}
voice22=function(){
 // Stopping an active recorder is never gated by an unrelated busy flag.
 if(voiceRun27||rec22){stopVoice27(false);return;}
 if(sheet22.busy||!isSheet22())return;
 const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
 if(!SR){sheet22.msg='此瀏覽器不提供網頁語音辨識，可用手機鍵盤的麥克風輸入。';redraw22();return;}
 const base=document.getElementById('expense-text22')?.value??sheet22.text;
 let r;try{r=new SR();}catch(_){sheet22.msg='瀏覽器無法啟動語音辨識，請使用鍵盤語音輸入。';redraw22();return;}
 const v={r,session:sheet22.session,base,done:false,stopping:false,send:false,timer:null};
 voiceRun27=v;rec22=r;micSend25=false;++micAttempt25;
 r.lang='zh-TW';r.interimResults=true;r.continuous=false;
 sheet22.msg='';redraw22();
 r.onresult=e=>{
  if(!liveVoice27(v))return;
  const spoken=Array.from(e.results||[]).map(x=>x[0]?.transcript||'').join('');
  sheet22.text=v.base+(v.base.trim()&&spoken?'，':'')+spoken;
  const el=document.getElementById('expense-text22');if(el)el.value=sheet22.text;
  updateFooter25();
 };
 r.onerror=e=>{
  if(!liveVoice27(v))return;
  const stopped=v.stopping||e.error==='aborted';
  const message=stopped?'錄音已結束，已保留辨識文字。':
   ['not-allowed','service-not-allowed'].includes(e.error)?'麥克風權限未開啟，請允許後再試；已保留原本的文字。':
   e.error==='no-speech'?'沒有聽到內容，已結束錄音；可再按麥克風。':
   e.error==='network'?'語音服务連線中斷，已保留文字；可重試或用鍵盤輸入。'.replace('服务','服務'):
   '語音辨識已停止，文字已保留；可重新錄音或直接輸入。';
  endVoice27(v,{abort:true,message,send:stopped&&v.send});
 };
 r.onend=()=>{if(liveVoice27(v))endVoice27(v,{send:v.send});};
 try{r.start();}catch(_){endVoice27(v,{abort:true,message:'無法啟動麥克風，請確認瀏覽器權限；原本的文字仍保留。'});}
};

}

  if(items.length){sheet22.text='';sheet22.images=[];}
 }catch(err){
  if(!current()||err?.code==='cancelled')return;
  apiCloud29.state='error';apiCloud29.message=String(err?.message||'AI API 未完成');

  if(items.length)sheet22.text='';if(images.length){sheet22.images=images;sheet22.msg+=' 照片尚未辨識，已保留。';}
 }finally{if(current()){sheet22.busy=false;redraw22();}}
};
